question: The recently detected large underground lava tube on Venus from NASA’s Magellan spacecraft is located on the western flank of which volcanic feature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nyx Mons.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Radar data from NASA’s Magellan spacecraft has revealed a large underground lava tube on Venus.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The underground cavity was detected on the western flank of Nyx Mons, a shield volcano on Venus.**
 
• The structure is interpreted as part of an empty lava tube formed by volcanic activity.
 
• The estimated average diameter of the lava tube is about 1 km, with a cavity height of at least 375 meters.
 
• This marks the first subsurface feature ever directly detected on Venus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Magellan Spacecraft__

 __
 
• Launched by NASA in 1989 to map the surface of Venus.
 
• Used Synthetic Aperture Radar to penetrate Venus’s dense cloud cover.
 
 
 
• Lava Tube__
 __
 
• Natural underground tunnel formed by flowing lava beneath a hardened crust.
 
• Commonly found in basaltic volcanic regions on Earth, and also on the Moon and Mars.
 
 
 
• Shield Volcano__
 __
 
• Broad, gently sloping volcano formed by low-viscosity lava flows.
 
• Nyx Mons is an example of a shield volcano on Venus.
 
 
 
• Future Venus Missions__
 
 
• ESA’s Envision and NASA’s Veritas will carry advanced radar systems.
 
• These missions aim to study Venus’s geology and subsurface features in greater detail.
